name: Frigorific-Tempest
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by magnetic pole anomalies. Farther poleward, past tectonic rift valleys, the silence feels older than the soil.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.

The terrain around the escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
